purpose: RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization + SHA-256 payload digests, byte-identical across Python/Rust/TypeScript. No model types, no signing/trust logic (those arrive in 3B).

canonicalization.string_rule: non-ASCII serialized 'as is' (NOT \uXXXX); only \" and \\ escaped; control chars < U+0020 escaped per RFC 8785 3.2.2.2
canonicalization.number_rule: integer-valued floats render as integers; -0.0 -> 0; shortest exponent form (1e-9, not 1e-09) per RFC 8785 3.2.2.3 / ECMA-262 7.1.12.1
canonicalization.key_sort: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code-unit order (RFC 8785 3.2.3)

digest.input: RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 bytes of the payload object

cross_language_gate: All three bindings MUST emit byte-identical canonical bytes AND identical sha256 digests for every shared vector. CI asserts this directly (gate.rb).
note_on_step2: The step-2 golden GovernanceEvaluation vector (test-vectors/0.2/governance-evaluation-golden.json) uses the same payload; its payload_digest (sha256:58c84315...) matches this RFC 8785 canonicalization.
